questions.question: Five persons P, Q, R, S and T are sitting around a pentagon table facing the centre. T is immediate left to R, who is second right to P. Q is immediate left to S, who is exact left to P. Who is sitting exact right to P?
questions.solution:
Correct Option **- 3**

Five Person - P, Q, R, S and T.

1) T is immediate left to __**R, who**__ is second right to P.

__
 
• **Here R is second right to P.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/977a7f0d7ea7ca9d5a8eb75eeb5a7661418e55afc4baeaea5e0bd6b43a39a80b.png] 

2) Q is immediate left to **S, who**__ is exact left to P.

 
• **Here S is exact left to P.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa3bdbe2d214b664398aa041271f4e61fe9af7025bf1e9dc70a618a98e1e6ec1.png] 

This is the final seating arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c9e31026596867705c2fd27e72e3cf25605ad5e4f255caf8c9e7bb9b3d6baae.png] 

In the above diagram, we can see **T is sitting exact right to P.**

Hence, the Correct Answer is **'T'****.**

questions.question:
A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at each of the corners, while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of each of the sides.

E who sits at the centre of a side, sits to the fourth left of the G. Only one person sits between G and F. B is immediate neighbour of E. Only three people sit between B and A. A is not a neighbour of D. H sits to the immediate left of C. C sits second to the right of E.

Who sits fourth to the right of D?
questions.solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Four of them are sitting at each of the corners, while the other four are sitting at the exact centre of each of the sides.

1) E who sits at the centre of a side, sits to the fourth left of the G. 

2) Only one person sits between G and F. 

3) B is immediate neighbour of E. 

4) C sits second to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70e8ddc19929c20ed2a628a95240db07eca2854e93348272fedc661b8ac6728f.png] 

5) Only three people sit between B and A.

6) A is not a neighbour of D.

7) H sits to the immediate left of C. 

And, D will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c7e4bc7cdc828c299b8c2ed5382d34250ed2613622f2a0977210267f2724457.png] 

So, 'H' sits fourth to the right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact centre of the sides. F sits third to the left of H. F sits at one of the corners. C sits second to the right of G. G does not sit at any of the corners. G is not an immediate neighbour of F. A is an immediate neighbour of B. A does not sit in any of the middles of the sides. Only three people sit between A and D. Who sits second to the left of D?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F, G, and H are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.

1) F sits third to the left of H. F sits at one of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a930f4e1ae1abcbefd2f0fde21573389029b937e55f4bb550e55b2fb14c7cfe.png] 

 

2) C sits second to the right of G. G does not sit at any of the corners. G is not an immediate neighbor of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7625b8961667f3ceef579ec6928dd94f3c71680e47ee56993da0734ead003c1f.png] 

 

3) A is an immediate neighbor of B. A does not sit in any of the middle of the sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f92d443631624857f117dfb637e6bb6fb9413d24fe43281b69410b5fff9000cc.png] 

 

4) Only three people sit between A and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/558c29b616b7ef6d103f2e81a8b32dca92bf512e4cfcbcd849be87121b130794.png] 

 

5) E sits in the Vacant place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ed0adff692f36adac04b28abd2d23a9c170b450dfa3fc58c14f6d5174dc4ed1.png] 

 

Clearly, E sits second to the left of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"E".**

questions.question:
D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides. K sits third to the right of I. K sits at one of the corners. E sits second to the left of G. G sits at any of the corners. E is an immediate neighbour of I and D. F sits third to the right of J. H is the immediate neighbour of F and K.

How many people sit between I and F, when counted from the left of I?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) K sits third to the right of I.

2) K sits at one of the corners. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1852acc7c53ec344f98885afb52ff090b39b744de0a64522ce78270504cd928.png] 

3) E is an immediate neighbour of I and D.

4) E sits second to the left of G.

5) G sits at any of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3753491dc6d359ea7873235706dae6cc86842e4586ff5b8f1c5b9270297f8e10.png] 

6) H is the immediate neighbour of F and K.

7) F sits third to the right of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7b60ddf730a6f39bb71ba087d6488d03a017918e3c4002ca66f199ce5c6d8f.png] 

Here, we can see that two people sit between I and F, when counted from the left of I.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Two"**.

questions.question: I, J, K, L, P, Q and R are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Only three people sit between P and J. Q sits to the immediate left of J. No one sits to the right of R. Only two people sit between R and Q. K sits to the immediate right of I. How many people sit between L and K?
questions.solution:
**Given:** I, J, K, L, P, Q and R are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table.

1) Only three people sit between P and J.

2) Q sits to the immediate left of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f1b8ad688bc14dbd327bb6c88e70960a169dc92eb65ee1ff0d03ed25f2e7192.png] 

3) No one sits to the right of R.

4) Only two people sit between R and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da1326800c4e63bdba57d88478ad959874a733743a27a2e9dae6a9572d360283.png] 

5) K sits to the immediate right of I.

After positioning K and I only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2552188129be51f154913f3463e240522225cae128bb336e96d9e1d53976d591.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, two people sit between L and K.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
